dimensions.assessment: Affects visitors to Washington, D.C., during the holiday season and participants in the United States semiquincentennial celebrations.
dimensions.evidence: hundreds of thousands of people of the United States visit Washington, DC, each holiday season and attend outdoor exhibits

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes temporary holiday displays and light projections on public monuments for a brief five-day window.
dimensions.evidence: projected onto the surface of the Washington Monument for 5 nights of public display, during the period beginning on December 31, 2025, and ending on January 5, 2026

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal appropriations or funding amounts are stated in the text.
A localized, temporary request directed to a single executive department for holiday events.
dimensions.evidence: requests the Secretary of the Interior to authorize unique and one-time arrangements for the display of United States semiquincentennial materials

dimensions.assessment: Strictly limited to a five-day period from December 31, 2025, to January 5, 2026.
dimensions.evidence: during the period beginning on December 31, 2025, and ending on January 5, 2026

missing_information: Cost estimates for setting up and operating the temporary displays and projections.
importance_detail.rationale: Requests the Department of the Interior to authorize unique displays and projections on the National Mall and Washington Monument for five nights surrounding the transition to 2026.

label: H.J.Res. 133
title: Requesting the Secretary of the Interior to authorize unique and one-time arrangements for displays on the National Mall and the Washington Monument during the period beginning on December 31, 2025, and ending on January 5, 2026.
